item.title: Girls Aloud’s Nicola Roberts Welcomes Her First Baby With Fiancé Mitch Hahn
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of entertainment. Today, we're excited to share with you a special announcement from Girls Aloud singer, Nicola Roberts. She's just welcomed her first child, a beautiful baby girl!"
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "Nicola took to Instagram on Sunday to share the news with her fans, posting adorable photos of her newborn daughter. She wrote, 'Our beautiful baby girl is here... We haven't stopped staring at her perfect little face or kissing her softest little head.' The little one arrived healthy and content at 38 weeks, weighing 6.5lbs, and is already stealing hearts."
[Clip of Instagram post sounds]
Host: "Fellow celebrities, including her Girls Aloud bandmate Nadine Coyle, Sophie Ellis-Bextor, and Little Mix star Perrie Edwards, were quick to flood the comments section with congratulatory messages. Nicola and her fiancé, Mitch Hahn, got engaged in August 2024 and announced they were expecting their first child together on Christmas Day in 2025."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Nicola has been documenting her pregnancy journey on social media, sharing updates and photos along the way. From her 'surreal' baby shower on Easter to her surgery at 22 weeks to ensure the baby's health, Nicola has been keeping her fans in the loop. And now, she's finally met her little one, and it's clear she's absolutely smitten."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Congratulations to Nicola and Mitch on the arrival of their baby girl! We can't wait to see more updates from this lovely family. Thanks for tuning in to our show, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
